recordType.description: Identifies the record as a header record.

fileName.description: Unique file name for each type of file, such as Person, Employment, or Relationship.

fileType.description: Identifies the file type. The file type must match the extension of the file itself.

sourceId.description: Unique identifier associated with the vendor sending the file.

createDate.description: File creation date. Defaults to the effective date if none is provided.

createTimestamp.description: File creation timestamp. Defaults to the timestamp of the effective date if none is provided.

periodBeginDate.description: Marks the beginning of the data period. Typically defaults to the first day of the previous month unless otherwise defined by the client.

periodEndDate.description: Marks the ending of the data period. Typically defaults to the last day of the previous month unless otherwise defined by the client.

recordCount.description: Number of relationship records in the file.

employeeUniqueId.description: Employee identifier used to identify the employee record to which the non-employee person is associated.

employeeSourceAssignmentId.description: Assignment key used to identify the employee job when the same employee ID exists across multiple jobs under the same employer.

employerCode.description: Unique employer code generated by BenefitsIQ and used by the employer when providing these files.

employeeLastName.description: Employee's last name used to help identify the employee record. This field is used for identification and does not get loaded.

employeeFirstName.description: Employee's first name used to help identify the employee record. This field is used for identification and does not get loaded.

relationshipCode.description: Code representing the non-employee person's relationship to the associated employee. Available values are defined in the Relationship reference table.

relatedPerson.description: Contains demographic and contact information for the non-employee person associated with the employee.

firstName.description: Non-employee person's first name. Must reflect the non-employee's legal name.

lastName.description: Non-employee person's last name. Must reflect the non-employee's legal name.

nonEmployeeTaxIdNumber.description: SSN or ITIN of the non-employee person being reported. SSN may be omitted for a qualifying foreign national when the applicable reporting steps have been completed.

nonEmployeeTaxIdType.description: Identifies whether the non-employee tax identification number is an SSN or ITIN.

nonEmployeeUsCitizen.description: Indicates whether the non-employee person is a US citizen.

dateOfDeath.description: Non-employee person's date of death, when applicable.

personType.description: Identifies the type of person. For this relationship domain, the value is NONEMPLOYEE.

gender.description: Non-employee person's gender, used for actuarial valuations.

title.description: Non-employee person's title. Available values are defined in the applicable reference table.

suffix.description: Non-employee person's name suffix. Must reflect the person's legal name.

primaryAddressType.description: Indicates the non-employee person's primary address type.

primaryPhoneType.description: Indicates the non-employee person's primary phone type.

primaryEmailType.description: Indicates the non-employee person's primary email type.

preferredCommunication.description: Indicates the non-employee person's preferred communication method.

addresses.description: Nested address information associated with the non-employee person.

zipCode.description: ZIP or postal code associated with the address.

foreignAddressLine.description: Foreign address information when the country code is other than USA.

emails.description: Nested email information associated with the non-employee person.

email.description: Email address associated with the non-employee person.

comment.description: Additional comment associated with the email address.

phones.description: Nested phone information associated with the non-employee person.

countryCode.description: Country calling code associated with the phone number.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number associated with the non-employee person.

comment.description: Additional comment associated with the phone number.
